## Shipment review: APPROVED -> SHIPPED

Merged to main as f3244ad8 (d3227d80..f3244ad8), pushed to origin.

Post-merge verification actually run:
- Remote CI on main for f3244ad8: CI, Repo Hygiene, Changesets Version PR, Release -- all four success (run ids 32379108013, 32379107951, 32379107953, 32379107920).
- Pre-push hook re-ran make sanity green on merged main.
- Coverage threshold .ci/coverage-threshold.txt unchanged at 95.

The knot's load-bearing claim -- that the flake is gone -- was verified by
20 consecutive full-suite runs with 0 failures, against a measured baseline
of 2 failures in 13 runs at b693169e before the fix.

Known and deliberately out of scope: git_hooks_tests::hook_template_uses_installed_binary_when_path_is_stripped
can fail with ExecutableFileBusy (ETXTBSY) under heavy parallel load. That is
a different mechanism -- fork/exec fd inheritance, not PATH mutation -- and it
was observed only while two full make sanity runs ran concurrently on this
machine. Not addressed here; recorded so it is not mistaken for a regression.
